title: Meta and Apple team up to make Muse AI models run better on Macs
raw_excerpt: The new Muse Spark Open AI model can work on M5 Ultra Mac Studios. | Photo: Amelia Holowaty Krales / The Verge Meta announced the Muse Spark Open AI model today , claiming that it's the "most capable US open-weight model to date." But the company also says that it's the "the first model in its class" that can "run on your desktop using two Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios with the latest MLX framework." Meta and Apple, typically rivals , worked together on the launch and are publicly supporting each other. "Muse Spark Open - weights releasing today - runs great on new Mac Studios thanks to work with @johnternus and Apple," Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg said on X . summary: Meta 发布 Muse Spark Open AI 模型，宣称是迄今最强的美国开放权重模型，并首次实现可在两台搭载 M5 Ultra 芯片的 Mac Studio 上通过最新 MLX 框架本地运行。值得注意的是，长期互为竞争对手的 Meta 与 Apple 此次罕见公开合作、互相站台。这标志着开源大模型向消费级桌面硬件下沉的重要一步，也预示着本地推理生态的阵营重组。

title: 库克：苹果智能接入阿里千问大模型，10月底在中国发布测试版本
summary: 苹果 CEO 库克确认，Apple Intelligence 将接入阿里千问大模型，并于 10 月底在中国大陆发布测试版本，但 Siri AI 此次不包含在内。这是苹果在华 AI 落地的关键进展，也意味着阿里通义千问成为苹果中国区官方合作模型之一。对国内 AI 应用生态和端侧智能竞争格局都将产生实质影响。

title: Grok Voice 3.0
raw_excerpt: xAI announced Grok Voice 3.0, a speech-to-speech model with sub-second latency and improved customer-support performance.
summary: xAI 发布 Grok Voice 3.0，这是一款语音到语音（speech-to-speech）模型，具备亚秒级延迟，并在客服场景表现上有明显提升。语音交互是 AI 助手走向实时自然对话的核心能力，xAI 此举直接对标 OpenAI 的实时语音产品线，也显示其在多模态交互层的持续投入。

title: ChatGPT can peek at your Chrome tabs now
raw_excerpt: OpenAI's ChatGPT Atlas browser is gone , but now ChatGPT's Google Chrome extension is getting some upgrades that allow it to use the browser tabs you already have open. With the extension installed, OpenAI says ChatGPT can now view your browser tabs when you tag Chrome in ChatGPT's web or desktop app, posting a demo video showing someone asking ChatGPT to compare the three tabs they have open with sofas they're considering. A few big upgrades for Chrome users today! We're bringing the power of computer use to anyone who uses Chrome. First up: ChatGPT can now use your tabs in Chrome to make answers more useful and get things done for you. If  … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: OpenAI 为 ChatGPT 的 Chrome 扩展带来重大升级：安装后，ChatGPT 可读取用户当前打开的浏览器标签页，实现跨标签内容比较与操作。官方演示了对比三个沙发选购页面的场景。这是「computer use」能力向普通 Chrome 用户的普及，也意味着 AI 助手正从对话框走向直接接管浏览器工作流。

title: Accelerating the search for antimicrobial peptides with Google Antigravity
raw_excerpt: Accelerating the search for novel antimicrobial peptides using Google Antigravity for Science.
summary: Google DeepMind 发布博客，介绍利用 Google Antigravity for Science 加速新型抗菌肽（antimicrobial peptides）的发现。抗菌肽被视为对抗耐药菌的重要方向，DeepMind 将 AI 科学发现工具用于该领域，延续了 AlphaFold 以来「AI for Science」的路线，展示了模型在真实生物医药研发流程中的落地价值。

title: Scaling Indic Pretraining: 2.8 Trillion Tokens and an Open Data Generation Pipeline
summary: NVIDIA 在 HuggingFace 发布博客，介绍 Indic 语言预训练扩展工作：构建了 2.8 万亿 token 的语料，并开源了数据生成流水线。印度语言覆盖超十亿人口，但长期缺乏高质量预训练数据。该工作不仅补齐了多语言模型的数据短板，其开放的数据生成管线也对其他低资源语言社区具有直接复用价值。

title: Granite Switch 4.1: Chat, Decisions, and Speech from One Endpoint
summary: IBM 发布 Granite Switch 4.1，将对话、决策与语音能力整合到单一端点，延续其企业级开源模型路线。相比需要拼接多个专用模型的方案，单端点统一多能力可显著降低企业部署与运维复杂度。这反映出企业 AI 市场正从「堆模型」转向「简化集成」的务实方向。

title: HiRO-ACEv2: Simulating extreme weather at 3 km resolution for a fraction of the cost
raw_excerpt: HiRO-ACEv2 simulates extreme weather at high accuracy and generates global 3 km climate data at 1/300th the cost of X-SHiELD.
summary: Allen AI 发布 HiRO-ACEv2，可在 3 公里分辨率下模拟极端天气，生成全球气候数据的成本仅为 X-SHiELD 的 1/300。高分辨率气候模拟长期受限于算力成本，该模型大幅降低了门槛，对气候研究、灾害预警和农业规划等场景具有实际意义，是 AI for Science 在气象领域的代表性进展。

title: Claude Adds OpenTelemetry for Agent Observability
raw_excerpt: Anthropic added OpenTelemetry tracing across Claude Managed Agents, the Messages API, and Claude SDKs.
summary: Anthropic 为 Claude 平台引入 OpenTelemetry 追踪能力，覆盖 Claude Managed Agents、Messages API 及 Claude SDK。随着 Agent 系统在生产环境中承担长链路任务，可观测性成为刚需。此举让开发者能追踪 Agent 的调用链路与性能瓶颈，是 Claude 向企业级 Agent 基础设施迈进的重要补强。

title: Call Center Jobs Are Declining, but 14,000 Calls Show Humans Still Outperform AI
summary: 一项基于 14000 通真实通话的分析显示，尽管呼叫中心岗位数量在下降，但人类坐席在通话表现上仍优于 AI。该研究为「AI 取代客服」的叙事提供了实证反例，指出当前 AI 在真实复杂对话中仍有明显短板。对正在大规模部署语音客服的企业而言，这是一份值得参考的现实检验。
